question: Who received the Sporting Icon Award at the 2025 Laureus ceremony?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Serena Williams**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The legendary tennis player **Serena Williams** was honored with the **Sporting Icon Award** at the **Laureus World Sports Awards** held in **2024** (marking her status for the 2024-25 sporting cycle).
 
• The award ceremony took place at the **Palacio de Cibeles** in **Madrid**, **Spain**, on **April 22, 2024**. ***Hence, the option Serena Williams is correct.***
 
• This special recognition was given to **Serena Williams** for her extraordinary career and her profound impact on the world of **Tennis** and global sports.
 
• She is a **23-time Grand Slam** singles champion, holding the record for the most titles in the **Open Era**.
 
• The **Sporting Icon Award** is not given every year; it is reserved for individuals whose influence transcends the boundaries of their sport, advocating for **gender equality** and **social justice**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Novak Djokovic (Option A):**

 
 
• The **Serbian** tennis star **Novak Djokovic** was named the **2024 Laureus World Sportsman of the Year**.
 
• This was his **fifth** time winning this specific category, equaling the all-time record held by **Roger Federer**.
 
• **Djokovic** was recognized for his dominant **2023** season where he won three out of four **Grand Slams** (Australian Open, French Open, and US Open).
 
 
 
• **Aitana Bonmatí:**
 
 
• The **Spanish** footballer **Aitana Bonmatí** won the **Laureus World Sportswoman of the Year** award.
 
• She made history as the **first footballer** to win this prestigious individual honor, following her success in the **2023 FIFA Women's World Cup**.
 
 
 
• **Jude Bellingham:**
 
 
• The **Real Madrid** and **England** midfielder received the **Laureus World Breakthrough of the Year Award**.
 
• He was recognized for his phenomenal debut season in **La Liga** and his leadership on the pitch at a young **age**.
 
 
 
• **Simone Biles:**
 
 
• The **American** gymnast **Simone Biles** was awarded the **Laureus World Comeback of the Year**.
 
• She returned to professional gymnastics after a hiatus focusing on **mental health**, winning four gold medals at the **2023 World Championships**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Laureus World Sports Academy:** The winners are selected by a jury consisting of **69 members** of the **Laureus World Sports Academy**, who are all **living sporting legends**.
 
• **Founding:** The awards were established in **1999** by founding patrons **Daimler** and **Richemont** and supported by global partners like **Mercedes-Benz** and **IWC Schaffhausen**.
 
• **Retirement:** **Serena Williams** officially evolved away from tennis (retired) after the **2022 US Open**, finishing a career that included **four Olympic gold medals** and **319 weeks** as world number one.
 
• **Significance:** The **Laureus Awards** are often referred to as the "**Oscars of Sports**," celebrating the most remarkable sporting achievements of the **calendar year**.
